depends_on: Ueno-Agaoka 2002 classification of edge-to-edge monohedral triangle tilings of the sphere
notes: Reading-dependent. Side bound pi/2 (likely the illegible bound): yes, trivially, by the edge-to-edge families F = 4n ((n-1)/2n,(n-1)/2n,2/n) and F = 8n (1/2,(n-1)/2n,1/n), all sides < pi/2 but smallest angle -> 0. Edge-to-edge with sides < b, 37.38 deg < b <= 60 deg: maximum is exactly 120 (Ueno-Agaoka Corollary 3: every infinite family has a side > pi/3). Edge-to-edge F > 120 forces an angle <= 8 pi/F. Non-edge-to-edge: open (classification incomplete for all-rational angles, Chen-Liang-Wang 2025). Outside Lean: everything (classification cited; certificate/sides.py checks side lengths numerically).
